question: LLM-as-a-Judge (GPT-4o) 对科研结论的评分与人类同行评审的 Pearson 相关系数 r 在 0.75-0.85 区间内波动，但当研究结论涉及新颖方法学（Novel Methodology）时，r 降至 0.50-0.60，因为 Judge 缺乏领域内的隐性知识（Tacit Knowledge），此时需强制触发人类复核。

sources.title: An Empirical Study of LLM-as-a-Judge for LLM Evaluation: Fine-tuned ...
sources.snippet: Many studies have fine-tuned judge models based on open-source LLMs for evaluation. While the fine-tuned judge models are claimed to achieve comparable evaluation capability with GPT-4, in this work, we conduct an empirical study of LLM-as-a-Judge.

sources.title: Systematic Evaluation of LLM-as-a-Judge in LLM Alignment Tasks:
sources.snippet: Due to limited budget, we select GPT-4o for evaluation over GPT-4 from the list of commercial LLMs, despite GPT-4 being the most widely-used model in LLM alignment studies before the release of GPT-4o.
